title: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00010:part:1/1
title_original: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 9 (Allowances, etc.) Allowances, travel expenses, and other necessary expenses may be paid, within the budget, to members of the Committee (including subcommittees; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article), relevant public officials, experts, and others: Provided, That such payments shall not be made to public officials attending a meeting of the Committee in direct connection with their assigned duties. <Amended on December 9, 2025>
